description: Use this when you know an article slug, for example from list_published_articles. Returns that one post with its title, summary, category, tags, dates, and URL as JSON, or an error when no post has that slug.

slug.description: The article slug: the last path segment of its /blog/posts/ URL, for example conda-vs-poetry-vs-uv-vs-pip.

name: get_published_article
title: Get one Sudhanva article
